answer: Latency triangulation. Each epoch five random peers in distant regions fire a zephyr of signed pings at an identity and log the round-trip times. Light can't go faster, and a proxy can only deepen the delay canyon, never shrink it, so the times pin each responder to a rough spot. Two identities with the same fix share one reward, and a fix in empty tundra gets audited. Every extra clone thus needs its own always-on machine in its own region, a bill no farm can pool.
